group.name: markdown_view
group.text: Native Markdown rendering with the Qt built-in engine, token-based styling, streaming append, LaTeX formulas and Mermaid diagrams.
Streaming Append (simulated AI token output with live LaTeX and Mermaid rendering)

Diagrams are interactive: drag to pan, Ctrl+wheel to zoom, and a toolbar at the top right offers zoom in / out / reset / fit-width. The viewer is MermaidView, embedded as an overlay on the diagram slot; when WebEngine is unavailable it falls back to the built-in painted renderer (flowchart / sequenceDiagram / pie subset) with interactions kept.
MermaidView can also be used without MarkdownView: MermaidView("flowchart LR\n A[Start] --> B[End]"); syntax errors are reported via the render_failed signal.

## Rendering Capabilities
Body text supports **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~ and `inline code`.
- Unordered list item - Task lists are supported: - [x] Finished item - [ ] Pending item
> Quote blocks use the secondary text color, ideal for quotes and hints.
```python def fibonacci(n): a, b = 0, 1 for _ in range(n): a, b = b, a + b return a ```
| Syntax | Support | |------|----------| | Tables | Supported | | Code fences | Supported (mono font + background, no syntax highlighting) |
[Links use the theme primary color](https://github.com/KKPIP-Tech/InstructionX_UIKit)

Inline formulas: the mass-energy equation $E=mc^2$, and Euler's identity $e^{i\pi}+1=0$.
Block formula (quadratic formula):
$$\frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2-4ac}}{2a}$$
The `\[...\]` and `\begin{equation}` environments are also supported:
\[\int_0^\infty e^{-x^2}\,dx = \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}\]
\begin{equation} a^2 + b^2 = c^2 \end{equation}
Formulas are rendered asynchronously by matplotlib mathtext on a background thread and cached; the source is shown as a placeholder while rendering. `$...$` inside code fences or inline code is never treated as a formula.

Mermaid fences render as interactive diagrams (official mermaid.js engine, bundled with the package, no network), with full official diagram types and theme-token colors:
```mermaid flowchart LR A[User question] --> B{Understand intent} B -- Clear --> C[Search knowledge base] B -- Vague --> D[Ask for clarification] C --> E[Generate answer] D --> E ```
```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant U as User participant A as Assistant U->>A: Send question A->>A: Reason and retrieve A-->>U: Stream the answer ```
```mermaid pie title Time Distribution This Week "Coding": 40 "Reading docs": 25 "Design discussion": 20 "Others": 15 ```
An unclosed mermaid fence during streaming falls back to a code block and is reflowed into a diagram once closed; syntax errors show a failure placeholder.
